scope: Mesh builder, four conservative-component stationarity residuals and stopping criteria, threaded CPU LBM and fused transfer
physics: Preserve the existing low-Mach/Re contract, fixed geometry, viscosities, two-level time scaling and force normalization. No new turbulence or energy model.

criteria_fixed_before_execution.mesh_builder: Preview uses exact plan coordinates and ownership, shows grid lines and solid cell centres, supports zoom, validates unsafe guards/unresolved elements and reports memory before 3D allocation. Cancel has no project effect; Apply/save/open preserve all unrelated parameters.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.residual_definition: Volume-weighted L2 and Linf of differences of conservative rho,j_common divided by elapsed convective time, normalized with rho_inf=U_inf=1. Use only owned fluid cells at synchronized times. These are stationarity residuals, not residuals of a solved implicit NS system or turbulence accuracy.

analytic_residuals.cases: Known distinct changes of all four components on unequal cell volumes; ownership; exact zero; NaN rejection; dt scaling

criteria_fixed_before_execution.stopping: All four user thresholds AND minimum t* AND consecutive successful checks. Integral balance closure must never independently trigger convergence. Duration, absolute run-step cap, per-launch wall-time cap and user stop have distinct reasons. Default is fixed duration.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.monitor_restart: Previous conservative samples and convergence streak survive checkpoint. Residual CSV and loads match uninterrupted evolution; modified committed prefix rejected; uncommitted suffix preserved before rollback.

fused_transfer.cases: Pinned NumPy reference, arbitrary stencil order and zero-centering, stress, density, positivity and Mach rejection

thread_equivalence.cases: CPU 1 versus 2 threads, actual open airfoil, outflow and checkpoint; generated OpenMP pragmas must specify requested threads

criteria_fixed_before_execution.regression: Retain analytic/interface transport checks for optimized coupling and relevant stationary-wall/force/restart checks. Compare version 0.3 reference continuation with the new backend.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.performance: Measure warmed serial/reference/new/threaded whole coarse steps on identical cases; report repetitions and CPU quota. Do not promise linear scaling or a speedup not measured.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.gui: Actual installed Tk mesh apply/cancel, live residuals, stopping configuration, multi-thread selection, save/open and stop/resume without callback errors.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.offline: Unchanged pinned dependencies, installed wheel in a clean venv, blocked Python connections/DNS, fresh compiled kernels including OpenMP, CSV and GIF; exact delivered TXT checksum and update/rollback.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.experiment: No new aerodynamic-accuracy claim. Existing Ohtake comparison remains startup/inconclusive; if numerical evolution changes beyond roundoff, rerun the named short case and retain its experimental limitations.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.not_claimed: Airfoil spatial/statistical convergence, validated Cl/Cd/Cm, Windows/MSVC native execution or GPU
